title: Faye websocket-driver 0.5.0 before 0.8.0, permessage-deflate before 0.2.0, and websocket-extensions before 0.2.0…
description: A decompression bomb vulnerability exists in Faye websocket-driver versions before 0.8.0, permessage-deflate before 0.2.0, and websocket-extensions before 0.2.0. This flaw allows unauthenticated remote clients to send highly compressible messages that are fully inflated before the maximum message length is enforced, causing excessive memory allocation and potential server crashes.
